item.description: I’m going to start with the bad news first … I’m not much of a writer; in fact, it terrifies me. This Lent, I am trying to lean into discomfort.

item.title: Spring’s arrival brings seasonal changes and scientific significance
item.description: With spring right around the corner, the season has already made an early appearance this year with high temperatures, blooming flowers, pre-spring showers and later sunsets. But one lingering question remains: When is the first day of spring?
